item.title: 【Cinema Center】SERIES - Winx Club: The Magic is Back (720p)
item.description:
​
The Winx Club: The Magic is Back, also known as the Winx Club Reboot, is a CGI reboot animated fantasy series created by Iginio Straffi. It is serves as a reboot of the entire franchise and presents a changed animation style and character designs.

The reboot is produced by Rainbow S.p.A., Rainbow CGI, and Hampa Animation Studio. It is set to release in October 2, 2025 on Netflix and September 8, 2025 for the UK and has 26 episodes.

“When Bloom discovers she has magic, her life takes a wild turn. At Alfea, a school for fairies and witches, she meets five girls who become her best friends. Together, they're the Winx.”

Synopsis

“A modern fantasy saga set in a vibrant world of magic, friendship and courage, Winx Club The Magic is Back follows the awesome adventures of Bloom, a teenage girl from Earth who discovers that she is a fairy with extraordinary powers. The new version is a coming-of-age story in which Bloom and her fairy friends discover how to become more powerful as they transform into super-heroines in order to save the magic dimension from the dark forces who want to control it.”
Click to expand...
​
According to the show's creator, the series will be a new take and adaptation of the plot of the original series:

  • Aisha is now part of the group in the beginning of the series rather than being introduced later on the following season like in the original.
  • Alfea is now both of the school of fairies and witches rather than being only a school for fairies.
  • Kiko is so far to be only seen as a plush toy and as Bloom's diary whereas in the original, it is Bloom's pet rabbit.
  • Unlike the original series, the reboot now features female specialists, something similar to what Fate: The Winx Saga did.
  • Bloom's way of discovering her powers are different in the adaptions. In the original, she discovers her powers while trying to defend herself while the reboot she discovers it while she was writing her diary in her room.
  • Bloom's first encounter with the Winx is different, she meets Stella while in Gardenia but in the reboot, Flora is also present.
  • Sky and Brandon apparently does not switch their identities in the reboot.
  • More of Bloom's school life from Earth is shown compared to the original series.
  • The way Bloom gets her Magic Winx is similar to how Bloom got her fairy transformation in Fate: The Winx Saga.
​
  • This is the first season to air in the 2020s decade.
  • This is the first season to be completely in CGI.
  • This is the first season to not be animated by Rainbow S.p.A..
  • According to Iginio Straffi, Aisha's name will remained as Aisha in all languages/dubbing in the reboot instead of Layla

Yes, the first 13 episodes of the Winx Club reboot, titled Winx Club: The Magic is Back, were released in the UK on September 8, 2025, and will be released worldwide on October 2, 2025. The complete first season of the reboot is 26 episodes long, with the remaining 13 episodes scheduled for release in Spring 2026
